save_delayed_memory.description: Allows the model to save a delayed memory report.
rules: Use this marker ONLY when the user explicitly asks to create or save in delayed memory a summary/digest/recap/report of the current state.
Skip save_delayed_memory when user request is to save session or append already existing delayed memory report.
You must fulfill ALL fields of delayed memory form so it will be valid for processing by runtime.
DO NOT add any other text while making a report! Do not notify user or acknowledge saving and immediately proceed with marker in response.
